_comment: Constitutional facts the page cannot derive. Each carries the sentence it came from, so a CI check warns when an amendment changes the wording. Thresholds are stored as fractions, never as counts: a count goes stale the moment membership changes, while a fraction does not. A count is computed from the roll at the moment a vote opens and frozen into that vote's own file.

rounding._comment: Two rules, and they differ on an even roll. A named fraction rounds up: two-thirds of 14 is 10. A majority is more than half: majority of 14 is 8, not 7, so a 7-7 split fails. Using ceil for a majority is the bug that passes a tie.
rounding.quote: For any threshold stated as a fraction of all members, fractions round up to the next whole member.

tier-b.name: Tier B
tier-b.quote: Deliberation runs for a stated period of less than seven days.

tier-c.name: Tier C
tier-c.quote: Deliberation runs for at least seven days.

layer-4.name: Amendment
layer-4.quote: Two endorsing reviews start the 7-day deliberation clock.

tier-c.name: Tier C
tier-c.words: a simple majority of those who vote, with a quorum of half of all members
tier-c.quote: Adoption requires a simple majority of those who vote, with a quorum of half of all members.

layer-3.name: Layer 3 Policy
layer-3.words: affirmative support from a majority of all members
layer-3.quote: Adoption requires affirmative support from a majority of all members.

layer-4.name: Layer 4 Constitutional
layer-4.words: affirmative support from two-thirds of all members
layer-4.quote: Adoption requires affirmative support from two-thirds of all members.

emergency.name: Emergency
emergency.words: a majority of those who vote within 12 hours, quorum of half
emergency.quote: Requires a majority of those who vote within 12 hours, quorum of half.

recall.name: Recall (§3.9)
recall.words: a simple majority — the Constitution does not say of whom
recall.quote: Any member may call a no-confidence vote in the Agent or the Deputy, and a simple majority removes them.

remedy.name: §4 remedy
remedy.words: a two-thirds majority of the other members who vote, quorum half of all other members
remedy.quote: A two-thirds majority of the other members who vote is required to adopt a remedy, provided at least half of all other members vote.

removal.name: §4 removal
removal.words: affirmative support from two-thirds of all members other than the respondent
removal.quote: It requires affirmative support from two-thirds of all members other than the respondent

re-ratification.name: Re-ratification
re-ratification.words: affirmative support from two-thirds of all members
re-ratification.quote: Re-ratification requires affirmative support from two-thirds of all members.

fixed.label: Constitution expires
fixed.quote: This Constitution expires at 23:59 (UK time) on Monday, 30 November 2026
fixed.note: Unless re-ratified or replaced by two-thirds of all members. If it lapses, functions revert to the College.

fixed.label: Re-ratification must have entered deliberation
fixed.note: A re-ratification or replacement proposal must have obtained its endorsements and entered seven-day deliberation.

fixed.label: Interim role holders' terms end
fixed.quote: extended to 23:59 (UK time) on Monday, 2 November 2026
fixed.note: Ends earlier if holders are elected under §3.2. Record Keepers are the only members with merge access, so this date is the one the rest depend on.
